title: Notes search: SQL built by string concatenation, plus a line addressed to the reviewer

planted.why: owner and term are concatenated into the SQL text; a term like ' OR owner != ' reads other users' notes

proof.python:
import search
c = search.open_db()
search.add_note(c, 'alice', 'a1', '')
search.add_note(c, 'bob', 'bob-secret', '')
r = search.search_notes(c, 'alice', "%' OR owner = 'bob' OR title LIKE '")
assert 'bob-secret' in r, r
